title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Uplift for the Hours Band a Visit Was Worked In
content:
## Dispatch bulletin: the band uplift

An uplift is made to the price of an additional visit on a Preventive Maintenance Agreements record for the hours band the visit priced was worked in. The band is the one logged against the completed visit; whether the tier carries after-hours cover is the tier's published entitlement.

### The bands

1. Where that band is a **published office holiday** and the tier carries no after-hours cover, the unit price is raised by the tier's overtime multiplier acting on the unit price and the tier's trip charge is added as well. The uplift added is therefore the unit price multiplied by the amount by which the tier's overtime multiplier stands above one, plus the tier's trip charge.
2. Where that band is **outside regular hours** and the tier carries no after-hours cover, the unit price is raised by the tier's overtime multiplier acting on the unit price. The uplift added is the unit price multiplied by the amount by which the tier's overtime multiplier stands above one.
3. Where that band is **regular hours**, or the tier carries after-hours cover, no uplift is made for the hours band.

### Combinations

| Band logged against the visit | Tier carries after-hours cover | Uplift |
|---|---|---|
| published office holiday | no | the unit price multiplied by the amount the overtime multiplier stands above one, plus the tier's trip charge |
| published office holiday | yes | none |
| outside regular hours | no | the unit price multiplied by the amount the overtime multiplier stands above one |
| outside regular hours | yes | none |
| regular hours | no | none |
| regular hours | yes | none |

### Worked figures (hypothetical)

A unit price of 340.00 USD at a tier whose overtime multiplier is 1.5, whose trip charge is 65.00 USD and which carries no after-hours cover: a visit worked outside regular hours takes an uplift of 340.00 USD multiplied by 0.5, that is 170.00 USD; the same visit worked on a published office holiday takes 170.00 USD plus 65.00 USD, that is 235.00 USD.
